![Ringa Maroon, Black Rabbit of Luck and Chaos (By Vanilla Creampuff)](https://neoncitylights.wdfiles.com/local--files/legend:ringa/Ringa_Maroon_Black_Rabbit_of_Luck_and_Chaos.png)

**Name.** Ringa Maroon

**Lineage.** Splicer (rabbit)

**Age.** 24

**Height and Weight.** 3'8", 150 lbs

**Pronouns.** he/him

**Classes/Subclasses.** Source Coder (Beta Tester) 19, Mechanist 1

**Features.** A pair of long bull like horns set in front of long black ears, soft black fur, and a good bit of pudge

**Status.** Alive

Known by some as the Black Rabbit of Luck and Chaos, he has spent a lot of time is spent playing videogames in both sense tank and just on a high-end PC that has had far too many people try to break into it for a variety of reasons. Upbeat, generally slightly nervous ('cause what rabbit isn't?), and easily flustered.

Running started out as mainly just standing near people that were looking for a good day at work or for that extra bit of good luck needed to try and secure a promotion or raise, so plenty of intern work. And similarly, work for people that wanted to tag a place or potentially rob some small, corporate owned store by just standing around and generally making sure the poor dude working didn't get caught up in whatever grudge or ideal. Past that, being able to be a proper freelance runner, a lot of it was drug testing hence gaining horns from said testing. Beyond that throughout a semi-long career, mecha-puppets have been fought, various old world underground locations raided, and even a few bounty hunting jobs.

At this point, running still happens because everything is super expensive when working on big projects! Soon enough though, a proper lounge for games and potentially more proper reconnaissance will be made to work out of.

**Player.** Darsana#0610
